app.title: Obsidian Property Studio
app.subtitle: Obsidian PKM v1.1.0
safety.offline: Local-only · No network or AI required
overview.title: Workspace Overview
overview.lead: Understand, design, edit, and govern your Obsidian Properties. Runs entirely locally and remains strictly read-only towards your vault files.
overview.not_scanned_desc: Please enter your Obsidian vault directory path in the Vault tab and click Scan to get started.
action.discover_desc: Explore property keys, usage counts, and storage type distributions within active scope.
action.design_desc: Define property schemas from goal descriptions, reusing existing vault vocabulary transparently.
action.workspace_desc: Inspect existing frontmatter, perform semantic edits with real-time diff, and copy verified YAML.
action.relations_desc: Explore property links and body wikilinks across source and target scopes with 4-state classification.
action.health_desc: Diagnose naming drift, value inconsistencies, type conflicts, and missing required properties.
action.refactor_desc: Generate scope-bounded impact analysis for property renaming, merging, and value normalizations.
vault.title: Select Obsidian Vault
vault.lead: Property Studio is strictly read-only. No files are created, edited, moved, or deleted in your vault. Everything runs locally without accounts or API keys.
vault.untouched_ok: ✓ Verification Passed: Vault remains byte-for-byte untouched
vault.untouched_desc: Pre-scan and post-scan SHA-256 manifests match exactly across {count} files.
scope.title: Scope Configuration
scope.lead: Configure your active working context (Entire Vault, One Folder, Multi-Folder, or Single Note). Scope switches execute in-memory without disk rescans.
scope.select_folder_warn: Please select at least one folder.
workspace.title: Note Properties Workspace
workspace.lead: Search notes across the entire vault, inspect original frontmatter, edit properties with live semantic diffs, and copy verified YAML.
workspace.search_placeholder: Type note name or relative path...
workspace.fail_closed_dup: Duplicate YAML keys detected. Edit blocked fail-closed to prevent data corruption.
workspace.fail_closed_corrupt: Frontmatter parse failed or corrupt. Edit blocked fail-closed.
workspace.roundtrip_ok: ✓ YAML semantic round-trip verified. Safe to copy.
workspace.roundtrip_err: ✕ YAML round-trip semantic mismatch. Copy disabled.
fill.title: Fill & Copy Frontmatter
fill.lead: Fill property values according to the designed Schema. Valid YAML Frontmatter will be generated in real-time below for copy-pasting into Obsidian.
fill.invalid_status: ✕ Missing required fields or unresolved ambiguity
discover.title: Property Inventory Discovery
discover.lead: Inventory of all property keys, frequencies, storage types, and anomalies observed in active scope.
design.title: Property Schema Design
design.lead: Select what you manage and what you need to track. Studio proposes deterministic properties and compares them against your active scope and whole vault.
design.objects_title: A. What are you managing? (Management Objects, multi-select)
design.needs_title: B. What do you need to track? (Management Needs, multi-select)
design.extra_placeholder: e.g., Equipment deployment tracking suppliers and regulatory compliance...
design.require_selection_warn: Please select at least one Management Object or Management Need.
design.next_apply_existing_desc: Select an existing note, inspect current properties, and apply schema diffs
design.next_create_blank_desc: Fill in property values and generate copyable valid YAML frontmatter
schema.msg_in_scope: '{name}' already exists in current Scope. Reuse it to keep your schema consistent.
schema.msg_elsewhere: '{name}' exists elsewhere in this vault (outside current Scope). You can adopt this existing convention.
schema.msg_case_variant: This vault already uses a differently-written version of '{name}'. Reusing the existing spelling keeps filtering consistent.
schema.msg_overlap: '{name}' looks similar to an existing property. This is a possibility for you to judge — nothing is merged automatically.
schema.msg_new: '{name}' is not used anywhere in this vault yet.
fill.empty_desc: To generate frontmatter for a new note, please design or adopt a property schema first.
refactor.rename_target_conflict_warn: ⚠ Property '{target}' already exists in this vault ({count} notes). You may want to Merge rather than Rename.
refactor.choose_or_new: -- Select existing property (merge) or enter new --
ws.browse_placeholder: 🔍 Type note name or browse dropdown...
relations.title: Relationship Analysis Inbox
relations.lead: Analyze link structures between notes. Supports multi-folder Source and Target scopes, separates Property and Body links, and classifies into 4 states.
relations.prompt_check_name: Please enter a name for this relationship check:
relations.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this check?
health.title: Property Health Audit
health.lead: Transparent, explainable health audit computed strictly from in-scope notes, diagnosing naming drift, value drift, and type conflicts.
health.excellent_state: Vault property health is excellent. No deductions observed.
refactor.title: Safe Refactor Planning
refactor.lead: All refactor plans are strictly read-only analyses. Changes are never written to the vault automatically, making all affected notes and conflict points transparent.
proposal.title: External AI Proposal Import
proposal.lead: Import versioned Schema Proposal JSON produced by external agents. Property Studio validates locally and compares against your real vault.
proposal.paste_label: Paste Proposal JSON or Open File
proposal.paste_warn: Please paste a Proposal JSON first.
drawer.title: Detail Drill-down
